title: VTC Badges — Awards — Withdraw — payload
description: Withdraw an open offer of a badge before its recipient decides. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

awardId.description: The offer to withdraw. It must be `offered`.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the change for the badge's owners and administrators. Not shown to the recipient.

Response.title: VTC Badges — Awards — Withdraw — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/awards/withdraw/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/awards/withdraw/0.1#response.

award.description: The award as it now stands: `state` `withdrawn`, `decidedAt` set.
